_note: Ported from the browser version's UNIT_STATS and UNIT_NOTE. Field names match the source. Do not change numbers here without updating the design notes.

galli.name: Pachycephalosaurus
galli.note: Charges in. Each head-butt slows the enemy it hits for the rest of the battle

dilo.name: Dilophosaurus
dilo.note: Shooter that spits venom half the field. Grounds flyers it hits for 3s. Dodges half of charging hits

mega.name: Megaraptor
mega.note: Its bite also catches a second enemy. 20 damage to big units. Can't be stunned. Sprints in from reserve

bow.name: Triceratops
bow.note: Shots and spells do nothing to it (except the Laser Tank's beam). Charges, knocking back up to 6, and stops enemy charges

quetz.name: Stegosaurus
quetz.note: Tail swing hits up to 8 ground enemies around it and stuns the ones left standing for 2s

alamo.name: Alamosaurus
alamo.note: Barracks guard: bought at a barracks, never moves or attacks, and fights whenever the hex is attacked. Each stomp hits up to 4 enemies

brawler.name: Robot Brawler
brawler.note: Half size: 2 come for every Pachycephalosaurus. Misses heavy units 25% of the time

rarch.name: Robot Archer
rarch.note: Shooter. Fires 2 lasers a shot. Hits flyers (misses 20%)

rknight.name: Robot Knight
rknight.note: Armor like the Megaraptor. Each cut also hits 2 more units for 25%. Shield Wall: every 3 knights (up to 4 walls) lock shields. Arrows and lasers bounce off; 6 units shelter behind each wall (Archers first, then Brawlers). Only melee breaks a wall (30 health), then its knights are stunned 1s

rlong.name: Robot Longbow
rlong.note: Shooter. Fires 2 lasers a shot. Hits flyers (+2, misses 15%). Stun Shot: shots 1, 5, 9… stun the unit hit for 1s, even through armor. Never shelters behind a shield wall

drone.name: Robot Drone
drone.note: Flyer. Attacks ground units only. Dodges 5% of attacks

gunship.name: Robot Gunship
gunship.note: Flyer. Lasers (8) at ground units, rockets (10) at flyers

ltank.name: Laser Tank
ltank.note: Beam burns up to 10 units for 10 damage each, 3 times a battle

porc.name: Porcupine
porc.note: Shooter: quills, like Archer arrows. Hits flyers (misses 20%). Its quills prick back: a melee attacker that lands a hit on it takes 1 damage

rhino.name: Rhino
rhino.note: Rhino Charge: opens each battle running straight through the enemy army, 20 damage to the first unit it tramples and 10 to each after; it can't die until it stops. Smashes shield walls. A Super Stomp or War Trumpet stops it

kanga._note: taken out of the game (2026-11-07); its numbers stay so old saved games still load
kanga.name: Procoptodon
kanga.note: Shooter, like a Longbow. Hits flyers (misses 15%)

bat.name: Bat
bat.note: Flyer. Attacks ground units only. Takes half a space in the arena

gbat.name: Desmodus
gbat.note: Giant vampire bat. Flyer that hits flyers too. Goes after melee units first

eleph.name: Palaeoloxodon
eleph.note: Tusk sweep hits up to 5 ground units and shoves them back. War Trumpet at 2s: your Mammals do +2 damage and attack 0.2s faster for the rest of the battle, and every enemy's next attack misses

minion.name: Minion
minion.note: Cheap and many. Mages turn Minions into bigger units

mage0.name: Mage
mage0.note: Chain lightning: 5 damage to up to 20 enemies, ground or air, jumping from one to the next; reaches a quarter of the field. Every 2s, 20% chance to turn a Minion into a Minotaur

mage1.name: Mage (level 1)
mage1.note: Level 1: lightning reaches half the field and does 6

mage2.name: Mage (level 2)
mage2.note: Level 2: lightning reaches three quarters of the field and does 7

mage3.name: Mage (level 3)
mage3.note: Level 3: lightning reaches the whole field and does 7

minotaur.name: Minotaur
minotaur.note: Hammer hits up to 5 ground units. Charges in; its first hit kills outright (big units are stunned 4s instead)

griffin.name: Griffin
griffin.note: Flyer that hits flyers too. Swoops to the enemy front, knocks units back and screeches: shooters miss their next 2 shots, charges stop

dragon.name: Dragon
dragon.note: Flyer that hits flyers too. Fire breath burns up to 15 enemies every 8s. Opens with a fire run over the enemy that can't be shot
